title: Camera animation
summary: Keyframes: on a frame, place the camera and press I (Location) -- or turn on auto keying so every change is keyed -- then go to a later frame and move it again; Blender fills the frames between. A simple move: low beside the mushroom, then across the lawn, ending on the pipe and the bomb; the timeline end set to 150. Realistic handheld motion with a camera-shake add-on (influence 0.5). The focus distance keyed too, so the focus passes from the mushroom to the pipe at the back.

objects.name: Camera
objects.description: animated over frames 1-150 with shake and a rack focus

expected_result: A 150-frame shot that starts close on the mushroom and glides across the grass to the pipe and the bomb, the focus pulling from the mushroom to the pipe, with a light handheld wobble.

steps.note: frame 1: the camera low beside the mushroom; I > Location (and Rotation) -- with auto keying every change is keyed
frame 150: moved to the right, turned towards the pipe and the bomb
Camera Shakify add-on: a handheld preset, influence 0.5 so it is not too wild
Depth of Field > Focus Distance (right click > pick the distance on the mushroom's eye), I
a little later, still on the mushroom, I
as the mushroom leaves the shot, the focus passes to the pipe at the back, I
